t: Sleek, lightweight CO alarm with a non-replaceable, sealed-in lithium battery for 10 years of continuous protection. This slim, easy-to-use alarm is ideal for use in all living areas and can be installed on a wall or ceiling, or used freestanding on a table or shelf. It is also easily portable so can be taken away on holidays. Red LED will flash every 60 seconds to indicate a CO event has occurred.
